correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=2 and gamma>0, the tight-binding ladder spectrum separates into rung-parity path bands. A proved cyclotomic conjugate/trace lemma excludes every cross-band collision except path energies +1 and -1, possible precisely when 3 divides n+1. At the unique zero-energy eigenspace, the opposite-corner source has dark overlap 3/(2(n+1)) exactly when 6 divides n+1. A dissipative spectral argument ensures all other components decay. The standalone checker passed 93 independent polynomial, matrix and evolution tests.
